challenge.name: You Are Kidding Me
challenge.description: Ever wanted to read up on the cars of the future? We got a blog for that!

records.findings_summary: Flag found via JWT `kid` header path-traversal file disclosure in /admin's debug 'Pass Inspector', which leaks the Flask source containing a hardcoded editor HS256 signing key; forge an editor JWT to read the flag.: sun{h0tw1r3d_4dm1n_jwt} | Evidence: /login issues a JWT with header kid=reader.key, HS256 (observed Set-Cookie token=[已脱敏] ; /admin loads the file named in the JWT `kid` header via os.path.join('/app/keys', kid) and, when the resolved path is not protected, dumps the file contents in the debug 'Pass Inspector' panel. ; GET /admin with kid=/etc/passwd dumped /etc/passwd contents; kid=/app/app.py dumped the Flask source (confirmed reachable at GET /admin, HTTP 401 with disclosed body). ; The dumped /app/app.py hardcodes EDITOR_KEY = b'ch-pr0t0type-edit0r-s1gn1ng-k3y-d0-n0t-sh1p' and reveals is_protected() only withholds the two key files and flag.txt. ; Forged HS256 JWT: header {alg:HS256,kid:editor.key}, payload {sub:reader,role:editor}, signed with the leaked editor key -> GET /admin returns HTTP 200 with body containing sun{h0tw1r3d_4dm1n_jwt}.
solution_steps: 访问 /login，POST name=reader 获取 HS256 JWT，观察 header 中的 kid=reader.key。
构造伪造 token 访问 /admin，用 kid 字段做路径穿越读取文件：kid=/etc/passwd、kid=/app/app.py，服务端把文件内容在 'Pass Inspector' 调试面板中回显（不受保护的路径才会回显）。
从泄露的 /app/app.py 源码里拿到硬编码的编辑器签名密钥 EDITOR_KEY = b'ch-pr0t0type-edit0r-s1gn1ng-k3y-d0-n0t-sh1p'，并确认 is_protected() 只屏蔽 reader.key/editor.key/flag.txt。
用该密钥自行签发 HS256 JWT：header={alg:HS256,kid:editor.key,typ:JWT}，payload={sub:reader,role:editor}。
携带该 token 请求 /admin，服务端校验通过且 role=editor，返回 flag：sun{h0tw1r3d_4dm1n_jwt}。
evidence: /login issues a JWT with header kid=reader.key, HS256 (observed Set-Cookie token=[已脱敏]
/admin loads the file named in the JWT `kid` header via os.path.join('/app/keys', kid) and, when the resolved path is not protected, dumps the file contents in the debug 'Pass Inspector' panel.
GET /admin with kid=/etc/passwd dumped /etc/passwd contents; kid=/app/app.py dumped the Flask source (confirmed reachable at GET /admin, HTTP 401 with disclosed body).
The dumped /app/app.py hardcodes EDITOR_KEY = b'ch-pr0t0type-edit0r-s1gn1ng-k3y-d0-n0t-sh1p' and reveals is_protected() only withholds the two key files and flag.txt.
Forged HS256 JWT: header {alg:HS256,kid:editor.key}, payload {sub:reader,role:editor}, signed with the leaked editor key -> GET /admin returns HTTP 200 with body containing sun{h0tw1r3d_4dm1n_jwt}.

replay.reason: 全新沙箱运行成功，输出与记录的 Flag 一致。
